body:
I have your very detailed PR description, thanks for that! Really cool to read it.

> For instance, if we had attr1, attr2, attr3 and attr4 as facets and just want to have a transformData on attr2, we would have needed to specify

This is the part I have trouble understanding clearly. Why would we have to list all of them if we want them displayed by the default formatting?

From the jsdoc of the widget it says "Only use declared attributes" But here it seems you use an example where you want to show all attributes but only override the behavior of one.
